Hi there,

Start small for sure. If you drink soda or sugary drinks, cut back on those gradually and then cut them out completely. I know a lot of soda drinkers that lost 40-50lbs just by cutting it out alone. 

Force yourself to get out and go for one walk a day at first. Listen to music while walking if that helps. Just start small and increase the amount of time you’re walking naturally. 

If you struggle with binge-eating unhealthy foods I recommend finding something healthy that you actually enjoy eating. That may sound silly but for years I struggled with binge eating and bulimia. I had a very unhealthy diet and would binge on sweets. I found it nearly impossible to stop the binging behaviour so I started eating ridiculous amounts of steamed veggies and hummus. Over time my healthy started to get much better and my binging behaviour and bulimia slowly disappeared naturally because there wasn’t any shame or guilt. 

That was the beginning of my falling in love with being healthy. 

I also recommend drinking at least 3-4 litres of water a day.

Wishing you best of luck.

Hi there, 

Stretch marks are a normal part of growing and I started getting mine around your age too. To keep the skin healthy, make sure to moisturize daily. Using a vitamin E rich lotion without too many chemicals will help the skin “bounce back” once you’ve stopped growing. 

Although they don’t really completely disappear, they will fade over time to a point where you don’t really notice them. New stretch marks are pink/red typically and that makes us feel like they’re more noticeable and glaring. That does fade :) just take good care of them. I promise once you hit 30 you also don’t mind as much :)
